<details>
This PKGBUILD is a standard AUR packaging file for `rsv-ng`, a runit service management tool. It uses a VCS source (`git+$url`) pointing to the project's own upstream GitLab repository, with `sha256sums=('SKIP')` which is required for VCS sources and is normal practice. The `pkgver()` function uses standard git commands to derive the version string. The `package()` function simply installs known files (the main script, shell completion files for bash/fish/zsh/nushell, a man page, LICENSE, and README) into conventional FHS paths under `$pkgdir`. There are no network requests, no obfuscated code, no use of `eval`, `curl`, `wget`, or `base64` in unexpected contexts, no data exfiltration, and no modifications outside `$pkgdir`. Everything is consistent with ordinary AUR packaging for a script-based utility.</details>
